field_notes: exercise = Compendium activity description verbatim; met = Compendium MET value verbatim. muscles, equipment, cue, cue_url are null: the Compendium does not give them, and nothing was invented.
selection: Daily-life activities first, every code in Compendium code order: all of Self Care (11), Inactivity (17), Transportation (12), Home Activities (78), then the first 32 Lawn & Garden codes. Sexual Activity page deliberately skipped.
